text: The first path generator recognizes five HTTP method names during extraction, but its emission branch handles only Get and skips other methods. It stores the request body as _body without using it. The generated /me Get implements the existing unit-body request API and typed $select support. Success and body metadata guide code generation; they do not implement HTTP dispatch or runtime response validation. PATCH generation is a separate later entry.
title: The first Graph path generator emits GET while only recognizing other methods
